title: Georgios' Nemesis
description: Keeps a world alive between sessions: named people with memory and motives, and factions with their courts and chains of command. GM only. Needs the Nemesis companion on the GM's computer. Works on its own; with Georgios' Map Maker it builds on Map Maker's world, and with Georgios Scribbler it links the Scribbler's entries.

recommends.reason: Nemesis builds on the world Map Maker made (its realms, towns, rulers and history) and links Map Maker's journals.
Nemesis links each person to the entry the Scribbler keeps of them.
